evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: A correct final answer can conceal flawed reasoning or tool use, synthesized advice may lack source support, and superficially similar cases may require different diagnostic procedures.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Experiments across four chest X-ray benchmarks show that EGSE outperforms representative medical agents and skill evolution methods in reasoning accuracy while reducing tool calls.
